slides.texto_titulo:
FROM EMPTY YARD
TO FULL LAYOUT

slides.texto_pie: A blank grid is just... intimidating.
Same yard. One afternoon. One plan.

slides.texto_overlay:
Every bed on paper first.
No guessing once you're outside.

slides.texto_cuerpo:
Beds and kitchen
close to the house,
visited daily.
Coop and compost
close too — same
daily habit.
Greenhouse and
trees farther out,
visited less often.

slides.texto_pie: The Half-Acre Blueprint template, ready when you are.
